name: sponsorship-cv
description: Write a truthful, tailored UK-style CV and cover letter for a specific job, using only your own CV and the job description.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor your CV and cover letter to a job.
interface.longDescription: Sponsorship CV turns your existing CV and a job description into a tailored, UK-style CV and a specific cover letter. It works only from the facts you provide, asks about gaps instead of inventing anything, and ends with a checklist of what to verify before you apply. It does not search for jobs, submit applications or give immigration advice.
defaultPrompt: Tailor my CV to this job description.
Write a cover letter for this role using my CV.
Check which requirements in this job advert my CV is missing.
